name: Product showcase
description: Reveal the product, show its detail and a real use moment, land the benefit, end with a clear call to action.

scenes.label: Hook — product reveal
scenes.visualDirection: Open on the real product with a confident reveal so the viewer knows what this is within two seconds.

scenes.label: Hero detail
scenes.visualDirection: Close, tactile look at the product's material and finish.
scenes.promptScaffold: Close-up product shot of {appearance}. {camera}. {lighting}. Set on {setting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Use moment
scenes.visualDirection: A real everyday moment where the product fits the audience's life.
scenes.promptScaffold: {audienceWho} in {setting}, an everyday moment where a {categoryNoun} would be useful. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Benefit
scenes.visualDirection: Hold on the product while the strongest confirmed benefit lands.

scenes.label: Lifestyle beat
scenes.visualDirection: A warm, aspirational beat that matches the campaign tone.

scenes.label: Call to action
scenes.visualDirection: The product with the offer (if any) and the call to action.
